_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 46: 8-13 January 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He describes it with no water and says that if that is not happening then call it not for today or an off-word, that he saw it coming in July of last year, and that the Lord said this is what is coming and told Australia to take their authority and pray for rain.
mentions.quote: If that's not happening, then say it's not for today or it's an off-word
mentions.falsify_match: Severe drought in Australia.
mentions.falsify_miss: No drought, and he says so himself: then it is an off-word. This is the only place in the corpus where he states a falsification condition for his own claim in advance.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will set the tone of the whole year, repeats that it will set the rest of the tone of the whole year, and they land on February 24th.
mentions.quote: It will set the tone of the whole year. February 24th
mentions.falsify_match: Something on 24 February 2026 that visibly shapes the year.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes quietly. Third February date now in play alongside the 3rd and the 25th, with no content on any of them.

mentions.claim_text: He says that while looking at the new ballroom for the White House he could see the people in it and the party, and the storm outside, and that he does not know why he keeps seeing storms over Washington.
mentions.quote: I could see the storm outside. I keep seeing storms over Washi
mentions.falsify_match: A crisis in Washington while the ballroom is in use.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Storm is not distinguished as weather or metaphor, and he says he does not know why he sees it.

mentions.claim_text: He says people were disappointed and that he saw the Prince of Persia latching on to Babylon with his hands on it, and recalls warning about Persia over the years.
mentions.quote: I saw the Prince of Persia latching on to Babylon
mentions.falsify_match: Iranian control or influence over Iraq deepening.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The figures are the Daniel 10 territorial spirits, so the claim is about an unobservable actor.

mentions.claim_text: He describes something moving in a direction he struggles to convey, involving the wailing wall as he has seen it in pictures, saying it was moved and not as it is, and that he does not know how to describe it.
mentions.quote: Where you would see the wailing wall? It was moved
mentions.falsify_match: Structural change at the Western Wall, or construction near it.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He says outright he cannot describe what he saw.

mentions.claim_text: He says that on July the 6th of 2014 when he went to the tribulation he saw the one he believes was the Antichrist proclaiming that he was God, and that he was standing on a structure but lower down, and that it is exactly what he saw.
mentions.quote: I saw who I believe was the Antichrist that proclaimed that he was God
mentions.falsify_match: A figure making that declaration.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He hedges the identification himself with who I believe was.

mentions.claim_text: He describes something that looked like a tulip with pictures that looked like YouTube spinning all around, videos of it, and transfers of money wire to wire and bank to bank.
mentions.quote: there was transfer of money for wire to wire to bank to bank
mentions.falsify_match: A payments or media platform matching the description.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The tulip is the classic image of a financial mania and he does not gloss it.

mentions.claim_text: He says God will turn it into much if they listen, tells them not to be stupid or stingy and not to fear having enough when the blessing comes, and warns against deciding this is all there is and setting up shop.
mentions.quote: Don't be stupid and don't be stingy
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on giving rather than holding
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it puts the responsibility for an absent blessing on the listener's stinginess.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that during Biden's term he told them Trump would win, that everybody doubted it, that he said he would win by a landslide and would even win Michigan and all these states.
mentions.quote: I said he'll win by a landslide. And he'll even win Michigan
mentions.falsify_match: A pre-election video in this corpus saying it, and the 2024 result. Both halves are checkable and the first is here.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such prior video, or the states named do not match.

mentions.claim_text: He says they maintain the House by a little so the other side will not be able to impeach him all the way because they need both, that it will be a stalemate president and it will be bad, and that the Lord said if they pray they can turn this around.
mentions.quote: we maintain the house by a little. It will be a stalemate president
mentions.falsify_match: A narrow Republican House hold with the Senate lost.
mentions.falsify_miss: Any other split. Consistent with the 27 January call, which makes this the settled version rather than the red wave one.

mentions.claim_text: He says they were one heart, a pink red heart joined together like Valentine candy, but that he saw March highlighted before him, and that March was a hot month concerning Greenland and things ahead over the next sixty to ninety days.
mentions.quote: March was a hot month concerning the Greenland
mentions.falsify_match: A Greenland flashpoint in March 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet March. Hot is not distinguished as diplomatic, military or literal.

mentions.claim_text: They work out that it started really manifesting in 2018 or 2019 and settle that he spoke to them in 2018, and he says he told them COVID was coming and then told them another virus is coming after that.
mentions.quote: he's told us COVID was coming and then another virus is coming after
mentions.falsify_match: A 2018 or 2019 record of the COVID call. This predates the channel, so it cannot be checked in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such record exists anywhere.

mentions.claim_text: He says it happened today and asks what he told them they were after, answering that he saw major mining and that it was going to establish the dollar against the BRICS.
mentions.quote: I saw major mining. And it was going to establish the dollar against the BRICS
mentions.falsify_match: A Greenland minerals arrangement framed against BRICS, and a prior telling in this corpus saying so.
mentions.falsify_miss: Either half fails. The prior telling is checkable here.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in 2026 they will say it a lot but will not have the votes, because he said they will keep the House and so the other side cannot get rid of him, and that the Lord said the Senate is in jeopardy.
mentions.quote: we'll keep the house and they won't have the votes to get rid of him
mentions.falsify_match: Republicans keep the House and lose or nearly lose the Senate, with impeachment attempts failing.
mentions.falsify_miss: The House flips.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are going to be targeted and that they need to pray over the main Mormon base in Utah, that he saw mass casualties coming, that the Lord said to pray over these areas, and that he sees Salt Lake City.
mentions.quote: pray over the main Mormon base in Utah. I saw mass casualties coming
mentions.falsify_match: A mass casualty attack in Salt Lake City.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Mass casualties is a real escalation on the December telling, which said only an attack on the temple.

mentions.claim_text: He says the more vibrant the colours and the more things he sees, the hotter it is, and asks whether he is describing it well enough.
mentions.quote: the more vibrant the colors, the more things I see, this is very hot
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, but useful: it is the key to the colour sightings, which are otherwise uninterpretable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He asks them to play what the Lord said was coming to California, notes it is from January the 16th of 2025 and that it is almost a year, and calls it pretty neat.
mentions.quote: Play me first of what the Lord said was coming to California
mentions.falsify_match: He plays the original recording again rather than paraphrasing it, so the claim is checked on air. The 16 January 2025 video is in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: The clip does not say what he says it says.

mentions.claim_text: He acknowledges they may do a photo shoot that some believers find repulsive, but says they are on the right road, they have some traction and to look at what God is doing.
mentions.quote: repulsive to some men believers, but we're on the right road
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a defence of political allies against objections from his own side.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he thought a window is small and not a door, and reports being told I am not giving you a door, I am giving you a window, and to think about what he says more than what he does not, namely a window of opportunity for a major revival.
mentions.quote: I'm not giving you a door. I'm giving you a window
mentions.falsify_match: A revival inside a limited period.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, and the smallness of the window is doing the work: a brief opportunity missed is not a failed forecast.

mentions.claim_text: He says no, it is about the economy, repeats that it is about the economy, and that this will be about 2026.
mentions.quote: It's about the economy. This will be about 2026
mentions.falsify_match: The economy dominating 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. No direction is given, only the subject.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the black and yellow bumblebees, not little bees but like queen bees, all coming up out of the ground and swarming her head and stinging her, and that the Lord said I am removing her.
mentions.quote: they started to swarm her head and sting her. The Lord said, I'm removing her
mentions.falsify_match: A named woman removed from office in Minnesota.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. She has never been named across four tellings, and in December he said she might not even be in Minnesota.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have to have both the House and the Senate to do all the things they will try, that he saw the Senate was in trouble, that in the vision the House remained under Republican control but the Senate flipped blue.
mentions.quote: The House in the vision remained under Republican control. But the Senate flipped blue
mentions.falsify_match: House stays Republican, Senate goes Democratic in November 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Any other split. This is the clearest statement of the call and it can fail on one night.

mentions.claim_text: He notes it was two hundred and forty eight hours later and that there was a post saying they know there is greater corruption in California than in Minnesota and that they are coming for Gavin, and says he told them.
mentions.quote: We know that there's greater corruption in California than in Minnesota
mentions.falsify_match: He counts the hours to a post that matches what he said, which is checkable at both ends.
mentions.falsify_miss: The post does not say it, or the prior telling does not.

mentions.claim_text: He says America was in trouble but they were going to make sure they would not be, that he saw lots of slush funds, that the Lord said he is going to deal with it all and has warned them over and over.
mentions.quote: There were slush funds. I saw lots of it
mentions.falsify_match: Documented misuse of public funds.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Nobody is named.

mentions.claim_text: He says none of them have got away with it and they will stand and give an account for everything, that hell is hot, and that people may think they get away with corruption in their churches and doing wrong with the church's finances.
mentions.quote: They'll stand and give an account for everything. Hell's hot
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the accounting is after death.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they may think they got away with it on earth but will be held to account, even pastors, because to whom much is given much is required, and mentions the sex scandals.
mentions.quote: they'll hold an account even pastors
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says things are going to accelerate and they are at the point of no return, that 2026, 2027 and 2028 will be years of shakings, and admits he repeats himself a lot but says there is always a new face.
mentions.quote: We're at the point of no return
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: shakings with no measure.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says there is an expiration date on their problem tonight and they are not going to take it any further into 2026 as he saw today, provided they stop repeating the same mistakes and expecting different results, and tells them to change the course.
mentions.quote: there's an expiration date to your problem tonight
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and the condition puts any failure on the listener.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He prays that God will make much of the fishes and the loaves as the God of provision, and thanks him for creative ideas and for them hearing him.
mentions.quote: Thank you, Lord, for creative ideas that we hear you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a
